task_values.message: Standalone notebook taskValues.set calls were collected into a JSON exit value. Update downstream taskValues.get references and Fabric pipeline/parent-notebook bindings to consume this JSON; orchestration bindings are not generated.

description: Active Azure Databricks source-export to Microsoft Fabric mapping configuration. Loaded on each new converter process. This is not a Synapse conversion profile.

implementation_notes.rules.py: Compiles line rules and resolves the allowlisted widget_define, widget_get and secret handlers. JSON contains no executable Python.
implementation_notes.paths.py: Applies enabled path_mappings to quoted Python and SQL literal prefixes before legacy path detection. Supports explicit Tables/ destinations and dbutils_fs-scoped /tmp mappings; preserves f-string expressions.
implementation_notes.autoloader.py: Guarded Parquet stream conversion with explicit DDL or opt-in POC runtime schema inference and an existing availableNow Delta append sink. Optional removal of exact matched checkpoint/schema resets. Schema/discovery/replay semantics require runtime review.
implementation_notes.fabric_patterns.py: Handles notebook orchestration, explicit Unity Catalog table mappings, MLflow migration and scoped temporary filesystem paths. Environment-specific targets require developer mappings and runtime validation.
implementation_notes.dlt.py: Guarded all-or-nothing batch SQL DLT conversion to Spark SQL MLV definitions, static DROP constraints and inlined logical-view CTEs. Streaming and CDC/SCD2 require manual migration.
implementation_notes.converter.py: Executes cell conversion, parameter-cell creation, safe comment placement, syntax checks, %run path handling, %fs argument handling and manual fallback branches.
implementation_notes.parser.py: Uses magic-command patterns below. Databricks export header, separator and title parsing remain Python grammar logic.
implementation_notes.model.py: Uses excluded_rule_ids for scoring. AUTO, REVIEW and MANUAL semantics and the 0.5 review weighting remain Python logic.
implementation_notes.report.py: Uses setup messages through converter.py. Presentation and aggregate calculations remain Python logic.

rules.title: dbutils.widgets definition -> parameters cell
rules.message: Fabric has no widgets. The default became a variable in a parameters cell; values passed by a pipeline arrive as strings and dropdown choices are lost.

rules.title: dbutils.widgets.get -> parameter variable
rules.message: Replaced by the parameter variable of the same name (string typed). Configure parameter_defaults or supply a Fabric pipeline parameter; an empty fallback is not a resolved dataset selection.

rules.title: dbutils.widgets remove/removeAll
rules.replacement: \g<indent>pass  # [ADB2FABRIC] widgets are not used in Fabric

rules.title: Unsupported dbutils.widgets usage
rules.message: Widget call form not recognised (named arguments, non-literal names or other API). Convert to a parameters-cell variable by hand.

rules.title: getArgument (legacy widget API)
rules.message: Legacy widget API; use a parameters-cell variable.

rules.title: CREATE WIDGET (SQL)
rules.message: Databricks SQL widgets do not exist in Fabric. Use a parameters-cell variable.

rules.title: SQL ${widget} substitution
rules.message: Databricks SQL widget substitution does not exist in Fabric. Build the statement in Python with a parameter variable and run it with spark.sql.

rules.title: dbutils.fs.mount
checklist: dbutils.fs.mount call: confirm source URL, auth and mount point on Fabric
rules.message: Different signature and authentication (use a Key Vault token, not Databricks secrets or service principal conf). Prefer OneLake shortcuts or abfss paths.

rules.title: dbutils.fs.unmount / mounts
rules.message: Verify behaviour on Fabric.

rules.title: dbutils.fs.refreshMounts / updateMount
rules.message: No equivalent. Re-create the mount or use a shortcut.

rules.title: dbutils.notebook.run
rules.message: Fabric runs a notebook item by name. Configure notebook_mappings, check timeout_seconds, arguments, workspace, child lakehouse and exit value.

rules.title: dbutils.notebook.entry_point / context
rules.message: Databricks internal context API (run id, user, cluster tags). Use notebookutils.runtime.context for the Fabric equivalents.

rules.title: dbutils.secrets.get -> Key Vault getSecret
rules.message: Literal-scope calls convert to Fabric getSecret: Auto with a real configured vault URL, Review with a missing/placeholder URL and explicit setup dependency. Dynamic scopes and unsupported arguments remain Manual. Grant the execution identity access.

rules.title: dbutils.secrets list APIs
rules.message: No equivalent; manage secrets in Azure Key Vault.

rules.title: dbutils.library.restartPython
rules.message: Verify on the target runtime; the session restarts and state is lost.

rules.title: dbutils.library install
checklist: Notebook installs libraries via dbutils.library: use %pip or a Fabric Environment
rules.message: Use inline %pip or attach a Fabric Environment.

rules.title: dbutils.jobs.taskValues
rules.message: Task values have no equivalent. Return values with notebookutils.notebook.exit and read them from the pipeline activity output.

rules.title: pyspark.dbutils import
rules.message: notebookutils is preloaded in Fabric notebooks; remove the DBUtils bootstrap.

rules.title: Legacy DBFS / mount path
checklist: DBFS / mount / Volumes paths found: map to OneLake (Files/Tables), shortcuts or abfss URLs
rules.message: DBFS, mounts and Unity Catalog volumes do not exist in Fabric. Re-point to OneLake (abfss://<workspace>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/...), a shortcut, or the lakehouse Files path.

rules.title: abfss path (retained)
checklist: abfss:// paths retained: confirm the Fabric identity can read/write the storage account

rules.title: Table access needs a default lakehouse
checklist: Notebook reads/writes managed tables: attach a default lakehouse (or use schema-qualified OneLake names)

rules.title: spark.databricks optimizeWrite
rules.message: Renamed to the Fabric property; verify the property name and default for your Fabric runtime.

rules.title: Other spark.databricks.* setting
rules.message: Databricks-specific configuration; remove, or map to a Fabric/Spark equivalent (not converted).

rules.title: Auto Loader (cloudFiles)
rules.message: Configure autoloader.schemas with the actual explicit schema for supported Parquet file-stream migration. Unsupported options require manual migration; discovery/schema evolution/replay behavior needs validation.

rules.title: COPY INTO
rules.message: Databricks COPY INTO is not available. Use a Data Factory copy activity or an explicit read/merge.

rules.title: Delta Live Tables / streaming tables
rules.message: DLT requires semantic migration. Supported batch SQL definitions can become Fabric MLVs with explicit mappings; streaming, CDC/SCD2 and unsupported APIs remain manual.

rules.title: Unity Catalog statements
checklist: Unity Catalog / hive_metastore references: map catalogs and schemas to lakehouses / schemas
rules.message: Three-level Unity Catalog names and grants do not exist in Fabric; map to workspace, lakehouse and schema.

rules.title: Databricks SDK / Connect / Koalas
rules.message: Databricks-only library. Replace with a Fabric/OSS equivalent (for example pandas-on-Spark: pyspark.pandas).

rules.title: Databricks REST/CLI call
rules.message: Calls the Databricks control plane; replace with Fabric REST APIs or remove.

rules.title: SQL statement with Databricks-only clause
checklist: OPTIMIZE/ZORDER/VACUUM/HISTORY used: runs on Fabric Delta; verify retention and the lakehouse maintenance policy

rules.title: Unsupported dbutils API
rules.message: dbutils API with no mapped notebookutils equivalent.

run_with_parameters.title: %run with parameters
run_with_parameters.message: Parameters passed to %run are not carried over; convert to notebookutils.notebook.run or set variables first.

checklist_text.mlflow: Confirm the Fabric MLflow tracking URI, experiment target, permissions, model artifacts and run lineage before executing migrated tracking code.
checklist_text.autoloader: Resolve explicit source schemas and durable checkpoints; validate native-stream discovery/evolution and initial-load/replay behavior. Never reuse ADB checkpoints or unconditionally reset progress.
checklist_text.parameters: Configure parameter defaults or supply string values through Fabric pipeline bindings. Empty fallbacks are not a resolved dataset selection.
checklist_text.dlt: Validate Fabric MLV availability, source/target mappings, constraints and refresh orchestration. Streaming/CDC/SCD2 require a separate stateful migration; no pipeline schedule is generated.
checklist_text.task_values: Update downstream taskValues.get references and orchestration bindings to read and parse this notebook's JSON exit value. This is automatic notebook code conversion, not automatic job migration.
checklist_text.lakehouse: Attach a default lakehouse to the notebook (or use fully qualified OneLake names).
checklist_text.keyvault: Map each Databricks secret scope to an Azure Key Vault and grant access to the running identity.
checklist_text.storage: Re-point DBFS / mount / Volumes paths to OneLake, shortcuts, or abfss URLs; confirm storage permissions.
checklist_text.mount: Re-create mounts on Fabric (or replace them with shortcuts).
checklist_text.library: Install libraries through a Fabric Environment (inline %pip is session scoped).
checklist_text.unity: Map Unity Catalog / hive_metastore names to Fabric workspace, lakehouse and schema.
checklist_text.delta: Confirm Delta maintenance (OPTIMIZE / VACUUM) and retention policy for the Fabric lakehouse.
checklist_text.run: Make sure every notebook referenced by %run exists in the same Fabric workspace under the converted name.
